result.summary: The pinned upstream tree at commit 539881b (github.com/lakhindarpal/bookmark-manager, materialized under source/) is a client-only bookmark manager built with Ripple TS, Vite, Tailwind/DaisyUI, Valibot, and Dexie/IndexedDB. A single Bookmark record type carries id, title, url, hostname, favicon Blob, description, flat tags[], isPinned, isArchived, visitCount, createdAt, visitedAt (source/src/includes/store.ts:3-16). The DB 'BookmarkDB' v1 has one table 'bookmarks' keyed by id with createdAt and visitCount indexes (source/src/includes/store.ts:41-47). The single component App.tsrx implements: an add/edit dialog with Valibot validation (URL http/https, title, description, 1-5 tags), a library grid with Home/Archived tabs, tag-filter sidebar with per-tag counts, title-only search, three sort modes with pinned-first, Visit (increments visitCount/visitedAt then window.open), Copy URL, Pin/Unpin, Edit, Archive/Unarchive, and a Delete action available only on archived items with a 5-second Undo toast. Metadata/favicons are fetched opportunistically from third-party services (api.microlink.io, images.weserv.nl, Google favicon) behind a 'sparkles' button and a fallback path, with failures only console.error'd. No test files, no import/export, no collections/folders, no sync, no preserved page copies, and no test script exist in the supplied manifest.
